replicaCount.description: v1 supports single replica only (in-memory session store).

auditAdminGroups.description: IdP groups granted full /api/audit visibility. Independent of authz mode. See docs/setup/audit.md.

size.description: PVC request size (e.g. 5Gi). Used only when storage.type=pvc.

watchStreams.description: Watch (SSE) push streams for live resource lists. Server defaults to all-on; this block is the operator-facing opt-out / subset / per-user cap.

kinds.description: Empty/unset or 'all' = all on (server default). 'off'/'none' = disable. Otherwise a comma-separated mix of per-kind tokens (pods, events, configmaps, deployments, services, …) and group aliases (core, config, workloads, networking, storage, cluster). The server is the source of truth for the registry — see cmd/periscope/main.go::watchKinds; this schema mirrors the current tokens so unknown values fail at deploy time.

perUserLimit.description: Concurrent SSE streams per OIDC subject. 0 disables the cap (not recommended).

inspector.description: AWS Inspector v2 CVE surfacing (v1.1+). Opt-in. See docs/setup/values.md and docs/setup/cluster-rbac.md for the required IAM grants.

enabled.description: Master switch. Default false; existing v1.0.x deployments stay unchanged.

refreshInterval.description: Per-entry TTL as a Go duration (e.g. '6h', '30m').

evictAfter.description: Cooldown before a zero-ref entry is dropped from the cache.

hydrateBatchSize.description: Inspector ListFindings batch size during cold-path hydrate. Capped at 50 (SDK BatchGet limit).

awsAccess.description: AWS Access surface (#188): per-workload 'AWS access' tab + per-cluster reverse lookup. The block also tunes the iam:SimulatePrincipalPolicy probe behind the capabilities paywall. Requires the v1.1 EKS + IAM read perms on periscope-server's role — see docs/usage/aws-access.md and examples/aws-iam-policy.json for the full set.

enabled.description: Master switch for the new #188 surfaces (workload-permissions, capabilities, sensitive-catalog) and the per-cluster Pod informer driving PodsForSA enrichment. Default true. When false, the chart sets PERISCOPE_AWS_ACCESS_ENABLED=false; the server skips those three routes and the Pod informer. The four #178 /identity/* endpoints and the two #187 /iam/* primitives stay on regardless so v1.0.7 installs aren't regressed.

iamProbe.description: iam:SimulatePrincipalPolicy probe driving the MISSING_IAM_PERMS lock-pane's exact missing-perms list. Ignored when awsAccess.enabled is false.

enabled.description: When true (default), GET /identity/capabilities calls iam:SimulatePrincipalPolicy against periscope-server's own caller identity and reports the exact missing IAM action names on a MISSING_IAM_PERMS lock. When false, the response stays optimistically available with a note and the first real call surfaces any missing perm as a 403. Requires iam:SimulatePrincipalPolicy on periscope-server's role when true.

bridgeGroup.description: K8s group the EKS Access Entry binds Periscope's pod principal to on each managed cluster. Referenced by the periscope-impersonator ClusterRoleBinding.

adminTier.description: Issue #84: cluster-admin tier binding is opt-in. Default install does not render the periscope-tier:admin ClusterRoleBinding so CIS 5.1.1 / AWS Guardrails pass out of the box.

enabled.description: Render the periscope-tier:admin ClusterRoleBinding. Default false.

clusterRoleName.description: Target ClusterRole for the admin tier. Defaults to `cluster-admin`. Operators who want a tighter posture can point at a custom role (e.g. `cluster-admin-no-rbac` they ship out-of-band).

sharedRoleName.description: Issue #142: when auth.authorization.mode is `shared` and any clusters[].backend is `in-cluster`, the chart renders a periscope-shared ClusterRoleBinding pointing the periscope SA at this ClusterRole. Default `view` (read-only, safe). Set to empty string to suppress.

exec.description: Pod exec global defaults. Per-cluster overrides in clusters[].exec take precedence. See docs/setup/pod-exec.md.

agent.description: Optional agent backend wiring (#42). Default off; enable to host the per-deployment CA + tunnel TLS listener so periscope-agent pods on managed clusters can dial in.

listenAddr.description: Bind addr for the dedicated TLS listener hosting /api/agents/connect. Format :PORT.

tunnelSANs.description: Comma-separated DNS names baked into the server cert presented on the tunnel. Must include whatever hostname agents dial.

caSecretName.description: K8s Secret holding the per-deployment CA. Pre-created empty by the chart; server fills on first boot.

tunnelService.description: Optional second Service exposing the tunnel listener externally. Default disabled — operators wire NLB/TCP-LB themselves or port-forward for testing.

exec.description: Per-cluster pod-exec overrides. Partial overrides are fine — omitted fields fall back to the global .exec defaults.
